changed: A program you import from a Caller's Companion set is named the way Caller's Companion names it, by date and location, such as "2024/04/20 - NEFFA Contra Party".

When you import a Caller's Companion set you called throughout, your name is no longer repeated on every slot. You keep slot callers when the set's slots name more than one caller, when a slot names someone other than the set's own caller, or when the set is called by several people.

`buildCcPrograms` titles a program `YYYY/MM/DD - Location` (Location alone without a parsed date, the date alone without a Location), and keeps `ProgramSlot.guestCaller` only when a set's built slots name more than one caller or one other than the set's `Caller`, or the set's `Caller` names several people.
